entities.name: Kenneth Wendell Ravenell
entities.context: Sentenced to 57 months in federal prison for money laundering conspiracy

entities.name: District of Maryland
entities.context: Jurisdiction where the case was presided over

entities.name: law firm
entities.context: Entity whose bank accounts were used to launder money

red_flags.flag: Ravenell received drug proceeds from clients and associates who engaged in drug trafficking
red_flags.red_flag: Acceptance of illicit drug proceeds from known trafficking associates

red_flags.flag: used bank accounts of the law firm to launder more than a million dollars
red_flags.red_flag: Use of professional trust accounts for money laundering operations

red_flags.flag: used the law firm’s bank accounts to receive drug payments and make payments to attorneys retained to represent other members of the conspiracy
red_flags.red_flag: Commingling drug proceeds with legitimate legal fee payments

red_flags.flag: used the law firm’s bank accounts to make various investments on behalf of a drug trafficker client, concealing and misrepresenting the source of the funds
red_flags.red_flag: Investment services for clients with illicit fund sources

red_flags.flag: received substantial cash payments derived from drug sales as compensation for laundering money
red_flags.red_flag: Cash compensation directly linked to money laundering services

red_flags.flag: Ravenell gave a drug dealer advice on how to launder the millions of dollars of cash that the dealer’s marijuana sales generated
red_flags.red_flag: Providing explicit advice on structuring and laundering drug proceeds

red_flags.flag: advised the drug dealer to set up businesses that generated cash themselves and make investments in real estate projects, which the dealer did, in order to launder drug proceeds
red_flags.red_flag: Advising on layering through cash-intensive businesses and real estate

red_flags.flag: mixing cash generated by marijuana sales with cash generated by ticket sales
red_flags.red_flag: Mixing illicit drug proceeds with legitimate business revenue

red_flags.flag: Ravenell personally laundered his client’s drug proceeds using the firm’s attorney trust account
red_flags.red_flag: Direct laundering of drug proceeds through attorney trust accounts

red_flags.flag: accepted more than $1.8 million in drug proceeds and funds co-mingled with drug proceeds from entities and individuals associated with the drug dealer
red_flags.red_flag: Acceptance of large sums of co-mingled illicit funds

red_flags.flag: directed the payment of more than $1.2 million of these drug proceeds from the law firm’s accounts to various projects and third parties to benefit his client
red_flags.red_flag: Disbursing illicit funds to third parties to conceal source

red_flags.flag: paid Ravenell more than $350,000 in drug proceeds through an associate of the client
red_flags.red_flag: Use of intermediaries to deliver illicit cash payments

red_flags.flag: instructed the associate to convert the drug proceeds into money orders and other instruments to conceal the source of the funds
red_flags.red_flag: Conversion of cash to monetary instruments to obscure trail
